A '''brain transplant'''<ref name="FF133">{{FactFile|133|MOV 3-4|B-9D7 (Movo Brattakin's Assistant)}}</ref> was a procedure in which a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient's]] [[Brain/Legends|brain]] was transplanted into another body. After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Movo Brattakin]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[B-9D7]] implanted Brattakin's brain in [[Gender/Legends|his]] own robotic body, allowing the late Brattakin to continue his operations.
